title: Guacamole - My Favorite
description: Homemade guacamole: Definitive, straight-forward and iconic. And oh yeah, damn tasty. Alton Brown
ingredients: 3 medium ripe Hass avocados, halved and pitted (peel removed)
2 small Roma tomatoes, seeded and diced
directions: Place the avocado pulp and lime juice in a large mixing bowl and toss to combine. Add the salt, cumin and cayenne and mash using a potato masher, leaving some larger chunks for texture.
Add the onion, tomatoes, garlic, cilantro and jalapeno and stir to combine. (One person suggested a ¼ teaspoon of ground coriander as a secret ingredient.)
Lay plastic wrap (and/or water) directly on the surface of the guacamole to prevent discoloring (some have suggested sticking half an onion in before sealing).
